jobs.title: VP System Architecture
jobs.description:
ANYbotics is a fast-growing tech company dedicated to shaping the future of mobile robotics across multiple industries. Join our highly talented and motivated team of more than 200 people and work on cutting-edge robot technology.

The Opportunity

As VP of System Architecture, you will define the architectural direction for the next generation of ANYbotics robot platforms. You will shape how a shared modular foundation supports multiple robot variants, operational design domains, and future business models.

This is a senior, cross-functional role spanning the full technology spectrum, from AI and autonomy through hardware, software, mechatronics, functional safety, system integration, and factory industrialization. You will help determine how our robots evolve from strong individual products into a scalable family of platforms, balancing reuse, flexibility, performance, manufacturability, and long-term maintainability.

This role is not just about technical design. It is also about setting direction, driving alignment across teams, and helping the organisation make strong architectural decisions as we scale.

Market & Our Technology

ANYbotics is pioneering autonomous robotic platforms for industrial inspection and operations in challenging environments. From explosion-proof systems in oil and gas to agile robotic platforms for utilities and other industrial settings, our technology is built for environments where safety, reliability, and uptime are critical.

System Architecture is central to how we scale. The challenge is not only to build great robots, but to create the modular architecture, interfaces, and platform strategy that allow multiple variants to be derived from a shared core. This includes anticipating future customer needs, new domains, certification requirements, and external integrations such as fleet management, predictive maintenance, and digital twins.

With the right architecture in place, ANYbotics can move faster, reuse more effectively, and expand into new markets without rebuilding from scratch each time.

About us

ANYbotics is a leading robotics company specialising in advanced autonomous systems. With a successful Series B financing round closed and strong momentum in the market, we are entering an important phase of growth and international expansion.

Our mission is to transform industrial inspection and operations through world-class robotics. We combine deep robotics expertise with real customer deployments in demanding industrial environments. This is an opportunity to join at a stage where the technology is proven, the ambition is high, and the architectural decisions made now will have a major impact on the company’s future.

Your Contributions

•
 Define and govern the reference system architecture across hardware and software domains focusing on modules interfaces

•
 Build a modular platform strategy that enables multiple robot variants and operational domains to be derived from a shared architectural foundation

•
 Drive architectural decisions on interfaces, middleware, data models, integration patterns, and the software backbone that supports future platform scaling

•
 Define how reuse, configuration, and hardware-specific adaptation are handled so new variants can be developed without unnecessary redesign

•
 Lead platform-level trade-offs across performance, agility, endurance, safety, manufacturability, and cost

•
 Embed diagnostics, functional safety, cybersecurity, over-the-air updates, and certification requirements into the architecture from the outset

•
 Partner with senior engineering leaders across software and hardware domains, and through the system engineering community to align on direction, influence execution, and translate long-term architecture into practical delivery

Your Profile

•
 MSc in Systems Engineering, Electronics, Robotics, Computer Science, or a related field

•
 Significant experience in system architecture and modularity leadership within robotics, autonomous systems, medical devices, automotive, aerospace, or other complex mechatronic environments

•
 Proven track record of architecting and evolving complex platforms rather than one-off systems

•
 Experience defining modular architectures and enabling reuse across multiple product variants

•
 Strong understanding of hardware and software co-design principles across sensors, actuators, compute, control systems, middleware, and power management

•
 Good understanding of autonomy-related systems such as perception, localisation, navigation, motion planning, or fleet-level coordination

•
 Experience with real-time systems, platform middleware, and system integration (V model) in complex industrial or safety-relevant environments

•
 Ability to translate customer needs, business direction, and technical constraints into clear architectural decisions

•
 Experience balancing performance, safety, manufacturability, scalability, and product maturity in real-world systems

•
 Proven ability to influence across teams, drive alignment, and lead change without relying solely on formal authority

•
 Strong communication and influence skills, sound judgement, and the ability to simplify complex architectural questions for a broad technical audience

•
 Proven ability to translate company strategy and mid- to long-term technology vision into a clear, executable roadmap, along with effective governance to drive its execution.

Bonus Points

•
 Experience with safety-critical or regulated robotic systems

•
 Familiarity with Ex certification or related industrial safety constraints

•
 Experience with large-scale simulation environments, digital twins, or platform-level validation frameworks

•
 Track record of reducing time to market through platform reuse and stronger architectural discipline

•
 Experience embedding certification and safety pathways into architectural frameworks

•
 Experience supporting products that scale across multiple variants, deployment environments, or different operational design domains

We offer you a very exciting and dynamic work environment, the opportunity to become part of a fast-growing company and an ambitious team that is on a mission to change the industrial inspection market, a chance to leverage your experience and bring in your own ideas, a fair market salary, an attractive employee stock ownership plan, and a job in the city of Zurich.

Agency Policy: We are not currently partnering with external search firms or recruitment agencies. Any profiles or resumes submitted to ANYbotics employees without a prior written agreement will be considered public disclosure and the property of ANYbotics, involving no liability or fee for subsequent hiring.

descriptionByLocale.it:
ANYbotics è una società tecnologica in rapida crescita dedicata a modellare il futuro della robotica mobile in più settori. Unisciti al nostro team altamente talentuoso e motivato di oltre 200 persone e lavorare sulla tecnologia robot all'avanguardia. L'opportunità Come VP di System Architecture, definirete la direzione architettonica per la prossima generazione di piattaforme robot ANYbotics. Potrai modellare come una fondazione modulare condivisa supporta più varianti robot, domini di progettazione operativa e modelli di business futuri. Si tratta di un ruolo senior e interfunzionale che spazia allo spettro tecnologico completo, dall'intelligenza artificiale e dall'autonomia attraverso hardware, software, meccatronica, sicurezza funzionale, integrazione di sistema e industrializzazione di fabbrica. Ti aiuterà a determinare come i nostri robot si evolvono da prodotti individuali forti in una famiglia scalabile di piattaforme, riutilizzo bilanciante, flessibilità, prestazioni, manufacturability e manutenbilità a lungo termine. Questo ruolo non riguarda solo il design tecnico. Si tratta anche di stabilire la direzione, guidare l'allineamento tra le squadre, e aiutare l'organizzazione a prendere forti decisioni architettoniche mentre scaleremo. Mercato e la nostra tecnologia ANYbotics è pioniera di piattaforme robotiche autonome per l'ispezione industriale e le operazioni in ambienti difficili. Dai sistemi a prova di esplosione in petrolio e gas alle piattaforme robotiche agili per le utility e altre impostazioni industriali, la nostra tecnologia è costruita per ambienti in cui la sicurezza, l'affidabilità e i tempi di avanzamento sono critici. L'Architettura di Sistema è centrale su come scalare. La sfida non è solo quella di costruire grandi robot, ma di creare l'architettura modulare, le interfacce e la strategia della piattaforma che permettono di derivare più varianti da un nucleo condiviso. Ciò include l'anticipazione delle future esigenze dei clienti, nuovi domini, requisiti di certificazione e integrazioni esterne come la gestione della flotta, la manutenzione predittiva e i gemelli digitali. Con la giusta architettura in atto, ANYbotics può muoversi più velocemente, riutilizzare più efficacemente, e espandersi in nuovi mercati senza ricostruire da zero ogni volta. Informazioni su di noi ANYbotics è una società di robotica leader specializzata in sistemi autonomi avanzati. Con un successo del round di finanziamento della serie B chiuso e forte slancio sul mercato, stiamo entrando in una fase importante di crescita e di espansione internazionale. La nostra missione è di trasformare l'ispezione industriale e le operazioni attraverso la robotica di livello mondiale. Uniamo profonda esperienza nella robotica con vere implementazioni dei clienti in ambienti industriali esigenti. Si tratta di un’opportunità per unirsi a una fase in cui la tecnologia è dimostrata, l’ambizione è alta, e le decisioni architettoniche prese ora avranno un grande impatto sul futuro dell’azienda. I tuoi contributi
• Definire e governare l'architettura del sistema di riferimento attraverso domini hardware e software incentrati sulle interfacce dei moduli
• Costruire una strategia di piattaforma modulare che consente molteplici varianti di robot e domini operativi da derivare da una fondazione architettonica condivisa
• Guidare le decisioni architettoniche su interfacce, middleware, modelli di dati, modelli di integrazione, e la spina dorsale del software che supporta la piattaforma futura
• Definire come il riutilizzo, la configurazione e l'adattamento hardware-specifico sono gestiti in modo da poter sviluppare nuove varianti senza inutili riprogettare
• I trade-off di livello piattaforma di piombo attraverso prestazioni, agilità, resistenza, sicurezza, manifatturabilità e costi
• Integrare la diagnostica, la sicurezza funzionale, la sicurezza informatica, gli aggiornamenti over-the-air e i requisiti di certificazione nell'architettura fin dall'inizio
• Partner con leader di ingegneria senior attraverso i domini software e hardware, e attraverso la comunità di ingegneria di sistema per allineare sulla direzione, l'esecuzione di influenza e tradurre l'architettura a lungo termine in consegna pratica Il tuo profilo
• MSc in Ingegneria dei sistemi, Elettronica, Robotica, Scienza informatica, o un campo correlato
• Esperienza significativa nell'architettura del sistema e nella leadership di modularità all'interno di robotica, sistemi autonomi, dispositivi medici, automotive, aerospaziale o altri complessi ambienti meccatronici
• Provato record di tracciato di architetto e in evoluzione piattaforme complesse piuttosto che sistemi one-off
• Esperienza nella definizione di architetture modulari e nel riutilizzo di più varianti di prodotto
• Forte comprensione dei principi di co-design hardware e software attraverso sensori, attuatori, sistemi di calcolo, controllo, middleware e gestione della potenza
• Buona comprensione dei sistemi legati all'autonomia, come la percezione, la localizzazione, la navigazione, la pianificazione del movimento o il coordinamento a livello di flotta
• Esperienza con sistemi in tempo reale, middleware della piattaforma e integrazione del sistema (modello V) in ambienti industriali o di sicurezza complessi
• Capacità di tradurre esigenze del cliente, direzione aziendale e vincoli tecnici in chiare decisioni architettoniche
• Esperienza di bilanciamento delle prestazioni, sicurezza, manufacturability, scalabilità e maturazione dei prodotti in sistemi reali
• Prove capacità di influenzare le squadre, l'allineamento dell'unità e il cambiamento del piombo senza contare solo su autorità formale
• Forte capacità di comunicazione e di influenza, giudizio sonoro, e la capacità di semplificare complesse questioni architettoniche per un ampio pubblico tecnico
• Prove capacità di tradurre la strategia aziendale e la visione tecnologica a medio-lungo termine in una roadmap chiara ed eseguibile, insieme ad una governance efficace per guidare la sua esecuzione. Punti bonus
• Esperienza con sistemi robotizzati critici o regolamentati in sicurezza
• Familiarità con certificazione Ex o relativi vincoli di sicurezza industriale
• Esperienza con ambienti di simulazione su larga scala, gemelli digitali o framework di validazione a livello di piattaforma
• Tracciare il record di riduzione del tempo al mercato attraverso il riutilizzo della piattaforma e una più forte disciplina architettonica
• Esperienza incorporando percorsi di certificazione e sicurezza in quadri architettonici
• Esperienza di prodotti di supporto che scalano in più varianti, ambienti di distribuzione o diversi domini di progettazione operativa Vi offriamo un ambiente di lavoro molto emozionante e dinamico, l'opportunità di entrare a far parte di una società in rapida crescita e di un team ambizioso che è in missione di cambiare il mercato dell'ispezione industriale, la possibilità di sfruttare la vostra esperienza e portare le vostre idee, un salario di mercato equo, un attraente piano di azionariato dei dipendenti e un lavoro nella città di Zurigo. Politica dell'Agenzia: Attualmente non stiamo collaborando con aziende di ricerca esterne o agenzie di reclutamento. Qualsiasi profilo o curriculum inviato ai dipendenti di ANYbotics senza un preventivo accordo scritto sarà considerato la divulgazione pubblica e la proprietà di ANYbotics, che non comporta alcuna responsabilità o tassa per il successivo assunzione.

descriptionByLocale.de:
ANYbotics ist ein schnell wachsendes Technologieunternehmen, das sich der Gestaltung der Zukunft der mobilen Robotik in verschiedenen Branchen verschrieben hat. Schließen Sie sich unserem hochtalentierten und motivierten Team von mehr als 200 Mitarbeitern an und arbeiten Sie an modernster Robotertechnologie. Die Chance Als VP of System Architecture definieren Sie die architektonische Richtung für die nächste Generation von ANYbotics Roboterplattformen. Sie gestalten, wie eine gemeinsame modulare Grundlage mehrere Robotervarianten, operative Designdomänen und zukünftige Geschäftsmodelle unterstützt. Dies ist eine leitende, funktionsübergreifende Rolle, die das gesamte Technologiespektrum umfasst, von KI und Autonomie über Hardware, Software, Mechatronik, funktionale Sicherheit, Systemintegration und Fabrikindustrialisierung. Sie werden dabei helfen zu bestimmen, wie sich unsere Roboter von starken individuellen Produkten zu einer skalierbaren Plattformfamilie entwickeln, die Wiederverwendung, Flexibilität, Leistung, Herstellbarkeit und langfristige Wartbarkeit in Einklang bringt. Bei dieser Rolle geht es nicht nur um technisches Design. Es geht auch darum, die Richtung festzulegen, die Ausrichtung zwischen den Teams voranzutreiben und dem Unternehmen zu helfen, starke architektonische Entscheidungen zu treffen, während wir skalieren. Markt & unsere Technologie ANYbotics ist wegweisend für autonome Roboterplattformen für industrielle Inspektionen und Operationen in anspruchsvollen Umgebungen. Von explosionsgeschützten Systemen in Öl und Gas bis hin zu agilen Roboterplattformen für Versorgungsunternehmen und andere industrielle Umgebungen ist unsere Technologie für Umgebungen konzipiert, in denen Sicherheit, Zuverlässigkeit und Betriebszeit von entscheidender Bedeutung sind. Systemarchitektur ist zentral für die Skalierung. Die Herausforderung besteht nicht nur darin, großartige Roboter zu bauen, sondern auch die modulare Architektur, Schnittstellen und Plattformstrategie zu schaffen, die es ermöglichen, mehrere Varianten aus einem gemeinsamen Kern abzuleiten. Dazu gehören die Antizipation zukünftiger Kundenbedürfnisse, neue Domänen, Zertifizierungsanforderungen und externe Integrationen wie Flottenmanagement, vorausschauende Wartung und digitale Zwillinge. Mit der richtigen Architektur kann sich ANYbotics schneller bewegen, effektiver wiederverwenden und in neue Märkte expandieren, ohne jedes Mal von Grund auf neu aufzubauen. Über uns ANYbotics ist ein führendes Robotik-Unternehmen, das sich auf fortschrittliche autonome Systeme spezialisiert hat. Mit einer erfolgreichen Series-B-Finanzierungsrunde und einer starken Marktdynamik treten wir in eine wichtige Wachstumsphase und internationale Expansion ein. Unsere Mission ist es, industrielle Inspektionen und Operationen durch Weltklasse-Robotik zu transformieren. Wir kombinieren fundiertes Robotik-Know-how mit echten Kundeneinsätzen in anspruchsvollen Industrieumgebungen. Dies ist eine Gelegenheit, sich in einer Phase anzuschließen, in der die Technologie bewährt ist, der Ehrgeiz hoch ist und die jetzt getroffenen architektonischen Entscheidungen einen großen Einfluss auf die Zukunft des Unternehmens haben werden. Ihre Beiträge
• Definieren und Verwalten der Referenzsystemarchitektur in Hardware- und Softwaredomänen mit Schwerpunkt auf Modulschnittstellen
• Aufbau einer modularen Plattformstrategie, die es ermöglicht, mehrere Robotervarianten und operative Domänen aus einer gemeinsamen architektonischen Grundlage abzuleiten
• Führen Sie architektonische Entscheidungen über Schnittstellen, Middleware, Datenmodelle, Integrationsmuster und das Software-Backbone, das die zukünftige Plattformskalierung unterstützt
• Definieren Sie, wie Wiederverwendung, Konfiguration und hardwarespezifische Anpassung gehandhabt werden, damit neue Varianten ohne unnötiges Redesign entwickelt werden können
• Führen Sie Kompromisse auf Plattformebene bei Leistung, Agilität, Ausdauer, Sicherheit, Herstellbarkeit und Kosten
• Einbetten von Diagnose, funktionaler Sicherheit, Cybersicherheit, Over-the-Air-Updates und Zertifizierungsanforderungen in die Architektur von Anfang an
• Partnerschaft mit leitenden Engineering-Führungskräften in Software- und Hardware-Domänen und durch die System-Engineering-Community, um sich auf die Richtung auszurichten, die Ausführung zu beeinflussen und langfristige Architektur in die praktische Bereitstellung zu übersetzen Ihr Profil
• MSc in Systems Engineering, Elektronik, Robotik, Informatik oder einem verwandten Bereich
• Bedeutende Erfahrung in Systemarchitektur und Modularitätsführerschaft in Robotik, autonomen Systemen, medizinischen Geräten, Automobil, Luft- und Raumfahrt oder anderen komplexen mechatronischen Umgebungen
• Nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz bei der Architektur und Entwicklung komplexer Plattformen anstelle von einmaligen Systemen
• Erfahrung mit der Definition modularer Architekturen und der Ermöglichung der Wiederverwendung über mehrere Produktvarianten hinweg
• Starkes Verständnis von Hardware- und Software-Co-Design-Prinzipien für Sensoren, Aktoren, Compute, Steuerungssysteme, Middleware und Power Management
• Gutes Verständnis autonomiebezogener Systeme wie Wahrnehmung, Lokalisierung, Navigation, Bewegungsplanung oder Koordination auf Flottenebene
• Erfahrung mit Echtzeitsystemen, Plattform-Middleware und Systemintegration (V-Modell) in komplexen industriellen oder sicherheitsrelevanten Umgebungen
• Fähigkeit, Kundenbedürfnisse, Geschäftsrichtung und technische Einschränkungen in klare architektonische Entscheidungen zu übersetzen
• Erfahrung mit Balancing-Leistung, Sicherheit, Herstellbarkeit, Skalierbarkeit und Produktreife in realen Systemen
• Bewährte Fähigkeit, teamübergreifend Einfluss zu nehmen, die Ausrichtung voranzutreiben und Veränderungen zu leiten, ohne sich ausschließlich auf formale Autorität zu verlassen
• Starke Kommunikation und Einflussfähigkeit, fundiertes Urteilsvermögen und die Fähigkeit, komplexe architektonische Fragen für ein breites technisches Publikum zu vereinfachen
• Bewährte Fähigkeit, die Unternehmensstrategie und die mittel- bis langfristige Technologievision in eine klare, ausführbare Roadmap zu übersetzen, zusammen mit einer effektiven Governance, um die Umsetzung voranzutreiben. Bonuspunkte
• Erfahrung mit sicherheitskritischen oder geregelten Robotersystemen

• Erfolgsbilanz bei der Reduzierung der Time-to-Market durch Wiederverwendung von Plattformen und stärkere Architekturdisziplin
• Erleben Sie die Einbettung von Zertifizierungs- und Sicherheitspfaden in architektonische Frameworks
• Erfahrung mit unterstützenden Produkten, die über mehrere Varianten, Bereitstellungsumgebungen oder verschiedene operative Design-Domänen skalieren Wir bieten Ihnen ein sehr spannendes und dynamisches Arbeitsumfeld, die Möglichkeit, Teil eines schnell wachsenden Unternehmens zu werden, und ein ambitioniertes Team, das den Markt für Industrieinspektionen verändern möchte, eine Chance, Ihre Erfahrungen zu nutzen und eigene Ideen einzubringen, ein faires Marktgehalt, einen attraktiven Mitarbeiteraktienplan und einen Job in der Stadt Zürich. Alle Profile oder Lebensläufe, die an ANYbotics-Mitarbeiter ohne vorherige schriftliche Vereinbarung eingereicht werden, gelten als öffentliche Offenlegung und als Eigentum von ANYbotics, ohne Haftung oder Gebühr für die spätere Einstellung.

Anybotics est une société technologique en croissance rapide dédiée à façonner l'avenir de la robotique mobile dans plusieurs industries. Rejoignez notre équipe hautement talentueuse et motivée de plus de 200 personnes et travaillez sur la technologie robot de pointe. L'opportunité En tant que vice-président de l'architecture système, vous définirez la direction architecturale de la prochaine génération de plates-formes robotisées Anybotics. Vous façonnerez comment une fondation modulaire partagée prend en charge plusieurs variantes de robots, domaines de conception opérationnelle et futurs modèles d'affaires. Il s'agit d'un rôle principal et interfonctionnel qui s'étend sur l'ensemble du spectre technologique, depuis l'IA et l'autonomie jusqu'au matériel, aux logiciels, à la mécatronique, à la sécurité fonctionnelle, à l'intégration des systèmes et à l'industrialisation des usines. Vous aiderez à déterminer comment nos robots évoluent de produits individuels forts à une famille évolutive de plates-formes, équilibrer la réutilisation, la flexibilité, les performances, la fabrication et la maintenance à long terme. Ce rôle ne concerne pas seulement la conception technique. Il s'agit également de définir l'orientation, d'orienter l'alignement entre les équipes et d'aider l'organisation à prendre des décisions architecturales fortes à mesure que nous montons. Marché et notre technologie Anybotics est une plateforme robotique autonome pionnière pour l'inspection industrielle et les opérations dans des environnements difficiles. Des systèmes anti-explosion dans le pétrole et le gaz aux plates-formes robotiques agiles pour les services publics et d'autres environnements industriels, notre technologie est construite pour les environnements où la sécurité, la fiabilité et le temps d'arrêt sont critiques. L'architecture du système est essentielle à notre échelle. jobs.description:
ANYbotics is a fast-growing tech company dedicated to shaping the future of mobile robotics across multiple industries. Join our highly talented and motivated team of more than 200 people and work on cutting-edge robot technology.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a Senior Reinforcement Learning Engineer to join our Motion Intelligence team. You should bring deep expertise in reinforcement learning and policy optimisation, grounded in real-world robotics experience, and be excited to push the boundaries of autonomous robots. We are looking for someone who can provide senior-level RL and learning-based control guidance across the team — shaping how we train, deploy, and maintain learned policies on physical robots operating in demanding industrial environments.
Beyond RL expertise, we value engineers who take pride in writing clean, maintainable code, simplifying complex systems through thoughtful design, and championing sound interfaces and architecture.

At ANYbotics, we develop tailored software solutions that enable our legged robots to execute inspection and maintenance tasks with precision and consistency. This role sits at the intersection of cutting-edge RL research and production robotics — from sim-to-real policy transfer and reward engineering through to reliable deployment on mission-critical systems in the field. You’ll work across the full lifecycle — from early development prototyping through to mission‑critical, production deployments.

The Market & Our Technology

ANYbotics transforms industrial plants in the energy, process, and utility sector by introducing robotics to a wide range of novel applications that so far were beyond reach. Our customers are large asset operators and industrial service providers pioneering the use of robotics technology for inspection and maintenance. Our mobile robot ANYmal uses legs for extreme mobility in complex environments, camera- and LIDAR-based sensing for full autonomy and obstacle avoidance, and AI for high-quality and consistent inspection results. We develop numerous customised hardware systems, including the entire robotic platform, actuators, sensors, inspection payloads, charging systems, and all related ANYbotics electrical hardware.

Your Impact

• Lead the design, training, and deployment of reinforcement learning policies for robot motion — bridging the gap from simulation to reliable real-world performance

• Provide senior technical guidance on RL and learning-based control across the team, mentoring engineers and establishing best practices for policy development workflows

• Own and evolve the RL training infrastructure and sim-to-real pipeline, ensuring reproducibility, scalability, and fast iteration cycles

• Shape the technical vision for internal ML tooling and experiment management (e.g. training dashboards, automated evaluation pipelines), driving efficiency and rigour across the team's learning workflows

• Collaborate closely with cross-functional stakeholders to identify how to expand the robot's autonomous operational envelope

• Triage field issues related to locomotion, recognise failure patterns, and rapidly improve policy robustness based on real deployment data

• Write, deploy, and maintain efficient Python and C++ software for the learning and locomotion stack

Your Profile

• PhD in robotics, machine learning, computer science or a related field with a strong focus on reinforcement learning; alternatively, an equivalent track record of RL research and deployment in robotics Or

• Master's degree from a top-tier technical university (e.g. ETH Zurich, EPFL) in robotics, machine learning, computer science or related field and 5+ years of professional experience

• Proven track record of shipping ML models to the field and maintaining those solutions over time

• Solid grounding in robot control fundamentals and autonomous systems, including: motion control, state estimation, path planning and actuation

• Experience using robotic simulation tools such as Gazebo or Isaac Sim

• Strong understanding of sim-to-real transfer, domain randomisation, reward shaping, and policy robustness techniques

• Proficiency in Python and modern ML frameworks (PyTorch); working knowledge of C++

• Strong knowledge of Linux systems and middleware frameworks for integrating learned components into a larger software stack

• Pragmatic and solution-oriented mindset — comfortable balancing research exploration with production delivery

• Excellent communication skills in English

Bonus Points

• Experience training and deploying RL policies on physical robots — not just in simulation

• Development of scalable and modular robot architectures of motion control systems

• Experience with navigation systems and autonomous mobile robot operation in unstructured environments

• Interest in agentic engineering toolchains

• Experience leading software architecture design and software engineering best practices

• A solid grasp of physical systems, specifically multibody dynamics, electromechanical drive physics, energy optimization, and contact physics, to ensure learned policies respect hardware limits and transfer successfully from simulation to the real world

We offer you a very exciting and dynamic work environment, the opportunity to become part of a fast-growing company and an ambitious team that is on a mission to change the industrial inspection market, a chance to leverage your experience and bring in your own ideas, a fair market salary, an attractive employee stock ownership plan, and a job in the city of Zurich.

Agency Policy: We are not currently partnering with external search firms or recruitment agencies. Any profiles or resumes submitted to ANYbotics employees without a prior written agreement will be considered public disclosure and the property of ANYbotics, involving no liability or fee for subsequent hiring.

jobs.description:
ANYbotics is a fast-growing tech company dedicated to shaping the future of mobile robotics across multiple industries. Join our highly talented and motivated team of more than 200 people and work on cutting-edge robot technology.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a Product Quality Engineer to join our operations team in Zurich. In this role, you will own the product quality improvement process for our advanced robotic platforms, including ANYmal D and the upcoming ANYmal X. You will play a pivotal role in managing non-conformities, driving root cause analysis, implementing corrective actions, and establishing data-driven quality improvement practices across the company. This is a unique opportunity to work on a highly complex, cutting-edge robotic product in a cross-functional capacity, directly impacting product reliability and scaling our quality systems for global success.

The Market & Our Technology

ANYbotics transitions industrial workplaces into high-efficiency environments through autonomous robotic inspection. Our four-legged robotic platforms, ANYmal and ANYmal X, are engineered to navigate complex, rugged, and hazardous industrial sites, providing high-precision data collection and real-time insights. By automating these challenging tasks, we enable industrial operators in oil & gas, chemicals, power, and mining to increase workforce safety, optimize uptime, and streamline operations.

Your Impact

• Own and optimize the non-conformity management workflow and quality tools across the organization

• Ensure proper documentation, prioritization, escalation, and closure of critical quality issues

• Coordinate cross-functional teams across R&D, industrialization, production, and supply chain to rapidly investigate and solve hardware and software issues

• Drive structured problem-solving activities using methodologies such as A3, 5W2H, and fault tree analysis

• Foster and promote a robust, proactive problem-solving culture across engineering and manufacturing teams

• Define, maintain, and improve product quality KPIs and data dashboards to drive visibility

• Analyze quality data from production, testing, and field operations to identify trends, recurring issues, and systemic improvement opportunities

• Report product quality performance and key risks to internal stakeholders to enable data-based design and production decisions

• Support the monitoring, compliance, and auditing of projects under ISO 9001 and ISO 80079-34 standards

• Train multidisciplinary teams on quality assurance tools and modern problem-solving methodologies

Your Profile

• Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a highly related technical field

• 3 to 7 years of hands-on experience in Product Quality, Systems Quality, or Manufacturing Quality engineering

• Proven track record of managing non-conformities in a complex, multi-disciplinary technical product environment (such as robotics, automotive, medical devices, or advanced manufacturing)

• Deep expertise in structured root cause analysis and implementing effective corrective and preventive actions (CAPA)

• Solid experience building quality indicators, tracking performance metrics, and designing reporting structures or dashboards

• Exceptional collaborative skills with the ability to bridge gaps and align goals across R&D, operations, and supply chain teams

• Fluency in English with strong technical communication and documentation skills

Bonus Points

• Direct experience working with and maintaining ISO 9001 and ISO 80079-34 (explosive atmospheres) quality management systems

• Experience in a fast-growing hardware tech scale-up environment

We offer you a very exciting and dynamic work environment, the opportunity to become part of a fast-growing company and an ambitious team that is on a mission to change the industrial inspection market, a chance to leverage your experience and bring in your own ideas, a fair market salary, an attractive employee stock ownership plan, and a job in the city of Zurich.

Agency Policy: We are not currently partnering with external search firms or recruitment agencies. Any profiles or resumes submitted to ANYbotics employees without a prior written agreement will be considered public disclosure and the property of ANYbotics, involving no liability or fee for subsequent hiring.

jobs.description:
ANYbotics is a fast-growing tech company dedicated to shaping the future of mobile robotics across multiple industries. Join our highly talented and motivated team of more than 200 people and work on cutting-edge robot technology.

The Opportunity

As the Senior Manager of Product Structure, PLM & MES, you are the architect of the digital backbone that connects our robotic innovations to real-world production. In this high-impact leadership role, you will strategically own the implementation and evolution of our Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) and Manufacturing Execution (MES) systems and processes to scale with a rapidly growing product and manufacturing organization ("Digital Thread").
You will govern the product architecture for our complex mechatronic systems, ensuring that our Engineering BOM (EBOM), Manufacturing BOM (MBOM), and Service BOM (SBOM) are perfectly synchronized.
This is not just a systems role — it’s a business transformation mandate. You will define and execute the PLM and MES roadmap in collaboration with executive stakeholders, ensuring alignment between engineering, operations, product, and after-sales service functions. You’ll help us build an integrated, enterprise-grade ecosystem that accelerates product development, enables traceability, and scales product data excellence.

The Market & Our Technology

ANYbotics transforms industrial plants in the energy, process, and utility sector by introducing robotics to a wide range of novel applications that so far were beyond reach. Our customers are large asset operators and industrial service providers pioneering the use of robotics technology for inspection and maintenance. Our mobile robot ANYmal uses legs for extreme mobility in complex environments, camera- and LIDAR-based sensing for full autonomy and obstacle avoidance, and AI for high-quality and consistent inspection results. We develop numerous customized hardware systems, including the entire robotic platform, actuators, sensors, inspection payloads, charging systems, and all related ANYbotics mechanical hardware.

Your Impact

• Product Structure & Configuration Governance

• BOM Mastery: Define and govern multi-level BOM structures for complex robotic systems, ensuring alignment across Engineering, Manufacturing, and Service.

• Modular Architecture: Support platform-based development by managing product configurations, variants, and component reuse strategies.

• Data Standards: Enforce rigorous part-numbering schemes, revision control, and BOM rules to maintain 100% data integrity.

• PLM System Ownership & Digital Thread

• Platform Management: Own the strategic roadmap, implementation and functional administration of the PLM environment (e.g., Windchill, Teamcenter, CIM Database).

• System Integration: Manage the technical "Digital Thread" between CAD → PLM → ERP → MES, ensuring real-time synchronization of product and manufacturing data.

• Release Management: Oversee the lifecycle states, access controls, and workflows for all product releases and configuration baselines.

• MES & Manufacturing Data Integration

• Production Execution: Ensure the flawless transfer of product structures from PLM to the MES for production execution.

• Process Definition: Collaborate with Manufacturing Engineering to define production routings, assembly sequences, and digital work instructions in the MES.

• Traceability: Maintain "As-Built" traceability, ensuring consistency between MES production data and ERP production orders.

• Engineering Change (ECM) & Continuous Improvement

• Change Governance: Lead the Engineering Change Request (ECR) and Order (ECO) processes, ensuring controlled propagation of changes across all systems.

• Optimization: Drive continuous improvement in workflows to reduce NPI (New Product Introduction) cycle times and improve manufacturing scalability.

• Audit & Compliance: Conduct regular product data audits and implement corrective actions to ensure "Single Source of Truth" reliability.

Your Profile

• Master’s degree in Systems Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering

•
 7+ years of experience in Configuration, PLM and MES system management, administration and implem entation, ideally in hardware or complex mechatronic product environments

•
 Proven track record leading cross-functional PLM projects with enterprise impact — from roadmap design to hands-on delivery

•
 Strong technical knowledge of PLM architectures (e.g., Teamcenter, Windchill, Arena, CIM Database), MES systems (e.g. Tulip, Opcenter) and their integration with ERP, CAD, and quality systems

•
 Deep understanding of business processes spanning engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, and service

•
 Highly effective communicator with the ability to engage and influence at all levels, including senior leadership and management

•
 Demonstrated mentoring, training, or enablement of teams in system adoption and process maturity Fluency in English required; German is a strong plus

Bonus Points

• Prior experience in scaling PLM environments in a high-growth startup or SME

•
 Familiarity with quality management systems and industry regulations, e.g. ATEX directives

•
 Experience in AI-enabled or robotics-based product companies

We offer you a very exciting and dynamic work environment, the opportunity to become part of a fast-growing company and an ambitious team that is on a mission to change the industrial inspection market, a chance to leverage your experience and bring in your own ideas, a fair market salary, an attractive employee stock ownership plan, and a job in the city of Zurich.

• 7 ans et plus d'expérience en Configuration, PLM et MES gestion système, administration et implem tation, idéalement dans les environnements matériels ou complexes de produits mécatroniques

• Le mentorat, la formation ou l'habilitation d'équipes dans l'adoption du système et la maturité du processus Points bonus

• Expérience dans les entreprises de produits à base d'IA ou de robotique Nous vous offrons un environnement de travail très excitant et dynamique, l'opportunité de faire partie d'une entreprise en croissance rapide et d'une équipe ambitieuse qui est en mission de changer le marché de l'inspection industrielle, une chance de tirer parti de votre expérience et d'apporter vos propres idées, un salaire équitable du marché, un plan attrayant d'actionnariat salarié, et un emploi dans la ville de Zurich. jobs.description:
ANYbotics is a fast-growing tech company dedicated to shaping the future of mobile robotics across multiple industries. Join our highly talented and motivated team of more than 190 people and work on cutting-edge robot technology. We are open to internships all year round and post regularly.

We’re always looking for passionate, curious, and motivated interns to join our mission.

This is your chance to collaborate with world-class experts, gain real-world experience, and make meaningful contributions in a fast-paced, interdisciplinary environment.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a hands-on Robotics Lab Technician Intern for a 6-month period to support our engineering team with hardware maintenance, troubleshooting, and lab organization. In this role, you will focus on the physical upkeep and operational readiness of our robotics systems and testing environment. This is a highly practical, execution-focused position ideal for students or technical trainees seeking direct experience with robotics hardware.

The Market & Our Technology

ANYbotics is a fast-growing tech company dedicated to shaping the future of mobile robotics across multiple heavy industries. Our four-legged robotic platform, ANYmal, is designed to navigate complex industrial environments autonomously, performing inspections and data collection in places that are too dangerous or difficult for humans. Join our highly talented and motivated team of more than 200 people and work on cutting-edge robot technology in an agile, fast-paced environment.

Your Impact

• Inspect, diagnose, and repair robotics hardware and subsystems before and after testing cycles

• Build and maintain laboratory tools, infrastructure, and test benches to ensure optimal working conditions

• Organize the laboratory space, managing component inventory, tools, and safety protocols to maintain a clean, efficient workspace

• Assist technical staff with the physical setup, wiring, and mounting of sensors and hardware testing rigs

• Execute standard test protocols on robotics systems under the guidance of our engineering team

Your Profile

• Student or trainee currently enrolled in a hands-on technical program from a university, school of applied sciences, or a relevant vocational track

• Strong practical mindset with a genuine interest in troubleshooting, repairing hardware, and working with your hands

• Methodical and organized approach to keeping a structured, tidy, and safe laboratory environment

• Basic familiarity with electronics and sensors such as multimeters, wiring, and basic test equipment

• Good communication skills in English, both written and spoken, to collaborate effectively with our international technical team

Bonus Points

• Prior experience working in a makerspace, university lab, or automotive/electronics workshop

• Familiarity with Linux (Ubuntu) environment and basic command-line interfaces

• Basic soldering skills or experience with electrical crimping tools

Interested? Submit your application

We will contact you if your skills and experience are a good fit for the team and the role. Please note due to the high load of applications we will only contact those that are relevant. Thank you for your understanding.

We are only able to consider applications from Schengen-Area citizens (or any student enrolled at ETH and EPFL who require compulsory internship). For residents outside of Switzerland, you will have to find your own accommodation in order to apply for the L or B work permit.

Internship Details:

Start date: any time of the year and always on the 1st of the month

Duration: 6 months

Workload: 100% (Full time, Onsite)

Who can apply:

EU applicants for internships

The internship can be voluntary

A work permit is not required but the candidate needs a residence permit

Must be enrolled in a University

Non-EU applicants for internships:

Internship must be mandatory (supported by a letter from a university)

A work permit is required

Must reside in CH

What We Offer:

- Hands-on experience working on advanced locomotion software.

- Mentorship from industry experts.

- Opportunities to contribute to innovative projects.

- A dynamic and collaborative work environment.

- Potential for future full-time opportunities.

We offer you a very exciting and dynamic work environment, the opportunity to become part of a fast-growing company and an ambitious team that is on a mission to change the industrial inspection market, a chance to leverage your experience and bring in your own ideas, a fair market salary, an attractive and fun environment in the city of Zurich.

Unisciti al nostro team altamente talentuoso e motivato di oltre 200 persone e lavori sulla tecnologia robot all'avanguardia in un ambiente agile e veloce.

Il tuo impatto

• Ispezionare, diagnosticare e riparare hardware e sottosistemi robotici prima e dopo i cicli di test

• Costruire e mantenere strumenti di laboratorio, infrastrutture e banchi di prova per garantire condizioni di lavoro ottimali

• Organizzare lo spazio di laboratorio, gestire l'inventario dei componenti, gli strumenti e i protocolli di sicurezza per mantenere uno spazio di lavoro pulito ed efficiente

• Assistere il personale tecnico con la configurazione fisica, il cablaggio e il montaggio di sensori e piattaforme di test hardware

• Eseguire protocolli di prova standard sui sistemi robotici sotto la guida del nostro team di ingegneria

Il tuo profilo

• Studente o tirocinante attualmente iscritto in un programma tecnico pratico da un'università, scuola di scienze applicate, o una traccia professionale rilevante

• Forte mentalità pratica con un interesse reale nella risoluzione dei problemi, riparazione hardware, e lavorare con le mani

• approccio metodico e organizzato per mantenere un ambiente di laboratorio strutturato, ordinato e sicuro

• familiarità di base con l'elettronica e sensori come multimetri, cablaggio e apparecchiature di test di base

• Buone capacità di comunicazione in inglese, sia scritte che parlate, per collaborare efficacemente con il nostro team tecnico internazionale

Punti bonus

• Esperienza prioritaria che lavora in un laboratorio makerspace, nel laboratorio universitario o nel settore automobilistico/elettronico

• Familiarità con l'ambiente Linux (Ubuntu) e le interfacce di riga di comando di base

• Capacità di saldatura di base o esperienza con gli strumenti di crimpaggio elettrico

Interessante? Invia la tua richiesta

Vi contatteremo se le vostre competenze e la vostra esperienza sono una buona misura per il team e il ruolo. Si prega di notare a causa dell'alto carico di applicazioni che contatteremo solo quelli che sono rilevanti. Grazie per la vostra comprensione.

Siamo in grado di prendere in considerazione solo le domande dei cittadini Schengen-Area (o di qualsiasi studente iscritto a ETH e EPFL che richiedono uno stage obbligatorio). Per i residenti al di fuori della Svizzera, dovrete trovare il vostro alloggio per richiedere il permesso di lavoro L o B.

Dettagli di stage:

Data di inizio: in qualsiasi momento dell'anno e sempre al 1° del mese

Durata: 6 mesi

Carico di lavoro: 100% (Full time, Onsite)

Chi può applicare:

Candidati UE per stage

Lo stage può essere volontario

Un permesso di lavoro non è richiesto, ma il candidato ha bisogno di un permesso di soggiorno

Deve essere iscritto a un'università

Candidati non UE per stage:

Il tirocinio deve essere obbligatorio (supportato da una lettera di un'università)

È richiesto un permesso di lavoro

Deve risiedere in CH

Cosa offriamo:

- Esperienza pratica che lavora sul software avanzato di locomozione.

- Mentorialità da esperti del settore.

- Opportunità di contribuire a progetti innovativi.

- Un ambiente di lavoro dinamico e collaborativo.

- Potenziale per future opportunità a tempo pieno.

Vi offriamo un ambiente di lavoro molto emozionante e dinamico, l'opportunità di entrare a far parte di una società in rapida crescita e di un team ambizioso che è in missione di cambiare il mercato dell'ispezione industriale, la possibilità di sfruttare la vostra esperienza e portare le vostre idee, uno stipendio di mercato equo, un ambiente attraente e divertente nella città di Zurigo.

We are looking for a structured and detail-oriented PDM Intern to help build the digital backbone of our autonomous robotic systems. As we scale our product data, document control, and change-management practices, you will play a hands-on role in strengthening our engineering records and preparing our systems for future Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) adoption. This is not a theoretical side project—you will work on critical, real-world operational needs at the intersection of engineering, industrialization, quality, and certification. You will directly impact our readiness for regulatory audits (such as ATEX/IECEx) by transforming fragmented engineering documentation into controlled, searchable, and audit-ready product data.

Our customers are large asset operators and industrial service providers pioneering the use of robotics technology for inspection and maintenance. Our mobile robot ANYmal uses legs for extreme mobility in complex environments, camera- and LIDAR-based sensing for full autonomy and obstacle avoidance, and AI for high-quality and consistent inspection results. We develop numerous customized hardware systems, including the entire robotic platform, actuators, sensors, inspection payloads, charging systems, and all related ANYbotics mechanical hardware.

• Support the PDM-Extend rollout by onboarding CAD data and non-CAD documents into SolidWorks PDM, including cable drawings, test protocols, specifications, and compliance evidence

• Prepare, clean, and validate metadata for controlled document records, ensuring accurate tracking of document types, owners, statuses, and revisions

• Assist in testing and documenting PDM workflows for draft, review, approval, release, and revision-control scenarios

• Help build migration-ready datasets and folder/document structures that will be reused for future PLM implementation and vendor evaluation

• Evaluate and participate in the Polarion Application Lifecycle Management (ALM) Proof of Concept (PoC) according to our system architecture framework

• Create lightweight user support materials, including simple work instructions, screenshots, and known-issue logs for engineering, quality, and certification teams

Your Profile

• Currently studying mechanical engineering, industrial engineering, systems engineering, product lifecycle management, engineering management, robotics, mechatronics, or a related technical field

• Structured and detail-oriented working style with a high comfort level handling engineering documents, metadata, lists, and folder structures

• Basic understanding of CAD/PDM or engineering document-control concepts, with an eagerness to learn SolidWorks PDM quickly if not already familiar

• Strong ownership of repetitive but critical data-quality work, with the ability to follow defined rules and flag inconsistencies proactively

• Good communication skills in English and a collaborative mindset to coordinate effectively with engineering, industrialization, certification, quality, and IT stakeholders

• Proficiency with Excel or Google Sheets for data cleanup, including familiarity with lookup tables, structured lists, basic formulas, or simple dashboards

Bonus Points
 Exposure to SolidWorks, SolidWorks PDM, ALM, PLM, QMS, or other lifecycle-management tools

- Mentorship from industry experts.

descriptionByLocale.en:
ANYbotics is a fast-growing tech company dedicated to shaping the future of mobile robotics across multiple industries. Join our highly talented and motivated team of more than 190 people and work on cutting-edge robot technology. We are open to internships all year round and post regularly.

We’re always looking for passionate, curious, and motivated interns to join our mission.

This is your chance to collaborate with world-class experts, gain real-world experience, and make meaningful contributions in a fast-paced, interdisciplinary environment.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a structured and detail-oriented PDM Intern to help build the digital backbone of our autonomous robotic systems. As we scale our product data, document control, and change-management practices, you will play a hands-on role in strengthening our engineering records and preparing our systems for future Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) adoption. This is not a theoretical side project—you will work on critical, real-world operational needs at the intersection of engineering, industrialization, quality, and certification. You will directly impact our readiness for regulatory audits (such as ATEX/IECEx) by transforming fragmented engineering documentation into controlled, searchable, and audit-ready product data.

Market & Our Technology

ANYbotics transforms industrial plants in the energy, process, and utility sector by introducing robotics to a wide range of novel applications that so far were beyond reach. Our customers are large asset operators and industrial service providers pioneering the use of robotics technology for inspection and maintenance. Our mobile robot ANYmal uses legs for extreme mobility in complex environments, camera- and LIDAR-based sensing for full autonomy and obstacle avoidance, and AI for high-quality and consistent inspection results. We develop numerous customized hardware systems, including the entire robotic platform, actuators, sensors, inspection payloads, charging systems, and all related ANYbotics mechanical hardware.

Your Contributions

• Support the PDM-Extend rollout by onboarding CAD data and non-CAD documents into SolidWorks PDM, including cable drawings, test protocols, specifications, and compliance evidence

• Prepare, clean, and validate metadata for controlled document records, ensuring accurate tracking of document types, owners, statuses, and revisions

• Assist in testing and documenting PDM workflows for draft, review, approval, release, and revision-control scenarios

• Help build migration-ready datasets and folder/document structures that will be reused for future PLM implementation and vendor evaluation

• Evaluate and participate in the Polarion Application Lifecycle Management (ALM) Proof of Concept (PoC) according to our system architecture framework

• Create lightweight user support materials, including simple work instructions, screenshots, and known-issue logs for engineering, quality, and certification teams

Your Profile

• Currently studying mechanical engineering, industrial engineering, systems engineering, product lifecycle management, engineering management, robotics, mechatronics, or a related technical field

• Structured and detail-oriented working style with a high comfort level handling engineering documents, metadata, lists, and folder structures

• Basic understanding of CAD/PDM or engineering document-control concepts, with an eagerness to learn SolidWorks PDM quickly if not already familiar

• Strong ownership of repetitive but critical data-quality work, with the ability to follow defined rules and flag inconsistencies proactively

• Good communication skills in English and a collaborative mindset to coordinate effectively with engineering, industrialization, certification, quality, and IT stakeholders

• Proficiency with Excel or Google Sheets for data cleanup, including familiarity with lookup tables, structured lists, basic formulas, or simple dashboards

Bonus Points
Exposure to SolidWorks, SolidWorks PDM, ALM, PLM, QMS, or other lifecycle-management tools

Internship Details:

Start date: any time of the year and always on the 1st of the month

Duration: 6 months

Workload: 100% (Full time, Onsite)

Who can apply:

EU applicants for internships

The internship can be voluntary

A work permit is not required but the candidate needs a residence permit

Must be enrolled in a University

Non-EU applicants for internships:

Internship must be mandatory (supported by a letter from a university)

A work permit is required

Must reside in CH

Interested? Submit your application

We will contact you if your skills and experience are a good fit for the team and the role. Please note due to the high load of applications we will only contact those that are relevant. Thank you for your understanding.

What We Offer:

- Hands-on experience working on advanced locomotion software.

- Mentorship from industry experts.

- Opportunities to contribute to innovative projects.

- A dynamic and collaborative work environment.

- Potential for future full-time opportunities.

We offer you a very exciting and dynamic work environment, the opportunity to become part of a fast-growing company and an ambitious team that is on a mission to change the industrial inspection market, a chance to leverage your experience and bring in your own ideas, a fair market salary, an attractive and fun environment in the city of Zurich.

jobs.description:
ANYbotics is a fast-growing tech company dedicated to shaping the future of mobile robotics across multiple industries. Join our highly talented and motivated team of more than 200 people and work on cutting-edge robot technology.

Are you a self-driven engineer who thrives on the shop floor? We are looking for a pragmatic, structured, and hands-on Manufacturing Engineer to join our Production and Maintenance Team in the heart of Zurich.

In this role, you work in the value stream, taking responsibility for our daily manufacturing operations. You provide first-level support and diagnose technical issues to maintain throughput and testing uptime. Your scope includes the maintenance of our current robot generation and driving the NPI execution on the shop floor, specifically the build and troubleshooting of prototypes and zero-series units.

You act as the interface between Industrialisation, Quality, R&D, Supply Chain, and Logistics, while collaborating with our EMS partner to ensure stable series production. If you have an "on-hands" mentality and want to implement KPIs to resolve bottlenecks in a high-tech scale-up, this is your next challenge.

ANYbotics transforms the industrial sector by introducing robotics to a wide range of novel applications that so far were beyond reach (see our case studies in Chemicals, Oil & Gas, Railways, Wind Energy, Mining, Construction). Our customers are large asset operators and service providers of industrial plants pioneering robotics technology f or inspection and maintenance. Our solution enables autonomous routine inspections and monitoring of large-scale industrial facilities for increased safety and productivity . We develop numerous customized hardware systems, including the entire robotic platform, actuators, sensors, inspection payloads, charging systems, and software to achieve world-class mobility, autonomy, and inspection capabilities, often based on AI. We have proven the t echnology and the business impact on our customers in long-term pilot projects. We are now scaling the commercialization of our solution(s) and deploying directly into operation at customer facilities worldwide.

• Document Non-Conformities (NCRs), perform root cause analysis, and implement corrective and preventive actions

• Take ownership of the maintenance, calibration, and improvement of production tooling and test equipment

• Monitor First Pass Yield (FPY) and throughput times consistently to proactively identify and resolve bottlenecks

• Lead projects and initiatives to optimize output, efficiency, and on-time delivery

• Drive the optimization of the end-to-end value stream for pilot series production and maintenance operations

• Execute New Product Introduction (NPI) and the implementation of Engineering Change Orders (ECOs) on the shop floor

• Ensure test procedures and work instructions are technically accurate and up to date

• Bachelor’s degree or technical diploma (HF/FH) in Electronics, Electrical Engineering, or Mechatronics

• 3 years+ experience in a high-tech manufacturing or robotics environment

• Strong troubleshooting ability with a self-driven proactive and structured mindset

• Experience with test instruments, oscilloscopes, DMMs, and power supplies

• Proven hands-on skills in soldering, crimping, and cable assembly

• Ability to work independently in a fast-paced, multicultural environment

• Excellent technical communication and presentation skills

• Fluency in German and English (Level B2 minimum)

• Knowledge of lean manufacturing or Six Sigma methodologies

• Experience with test data analysis or yield monitoring tools

• Familiarity with firmware update and validation workflows

• Driving license CH-Cat. B

ANYbotics is a fast-growing tech company dedicated to shaping the future of mobile robotics across multiple industries. Join our highly talented and motivated team of more than 190 people and work on cutting-edge robot technology. We are open to internships all year round and post regularly.

We’re always looking for passionate, curious, and motivated interns to join our mission.

This is your chance to collaborate with world-class experts, gain real-world experience, and make meaningful contributions in a fast-paced, interdisciplinary environment.

We’re always looking for passionate, curious, and motivated interns to join the Advanced Technology team. We explore emerging technologies and transform them into practical innovations that shape the future of robotics at ANYbotics. We bridge cutting-edge research with real-world industrial applications by rapidly validating new ideas, building prototypes, and transferring successful technologies into our products. Working closely with leading universities, startups, and internal engineering teams, we tackle challenging problems in robotics, AI, computer vision, and autonomous systems to create the next generation of industrial inspection robots.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a Reinforcement Learning for Robotic Navigation intern to join our Advanced Technology team and contribute to advancing ANYmal's mobility capabilities. Utilizing the latest reinforcement learning techniques and simulation tools, we define, train, and integrate ML models into ANYmal to safely and robustly navigate challenging industrial environments.

Your role includes evaluating and fine tuning state of the art RL-based navigation & locomotion policies in simulation and on real quadruped robots. This internship provides a profound and impactful opportunity to work at the forefront of machine learning in robotics, playing a significant role in shaping ANYmal's autonomous capabilities and contributing to real-world applications.

You will work closely with Robotics experts and research partners who will provide you with guidance and mentorship. The preferred starting date is September 2026 , and the full-time paid internship lasts six months.

Your Contributions

• Project Support: Work closely with our engineers and researchers on active projects across the entire software stack, from application software to autonomy stack and low-level software.

• Algorithm Implementation: Design, implement, test, and validate new algorithms and features in core software areas.

• Testing & Infrastructure: Contribute to the continuous improvement of our testing infrastructure, simulation environments, and CI/CD pipelines to ensure the robustness and reliability of the ANYmal platform

• Code Development & Testing: Write clean, efficient, and well-documented C++ and Python code for real-time operation on the robot. Contribute to our robust testing and simulation infrastructure

Your Profile

• Education: Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD program in Robotics, Computer Science, Electrical/Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related technical field.

• Foundational Knowledge: Solid academic knowledge and proven ability in one or more areas relevant to mobile robotics, such as Control Theory, Machine Learning, Computer Vision.

• Programming Skills: Strong proficiency in Python and/or C++ (Modern C++ is highly valued).

• Software Development Skills: Experience with Git, Docker, and AI-assisted software development tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot).

• Collaboration: Excellent communication skills and the ability to work effectively in our highly interdisciplinary, English-speaking environment.

• Attitude: A hands-on, proactive, and analytical attitude towards complex problem-solving and eagerness to learn rapidly.

Bonus points, a few extra things that would make us especially excited about your application

• You have trained AI models on GPUs and have explored CUDA or other GPU-accelerated computing frameworks.

• You spend your weekends automating your workflows with Agentic AI.

• You know and worked with Robotics Middleware (ROS/ROS 2).

Interested? Submit your application

We will contact you if your skills and experience are a good fit for the team and the role. Please note due to the high load of applications we will only contact those that are relevant. Thank you for your understanding.

We are only able to consider applications from Schengen-Area citizens (or any student enrolled at ETH and EPFL who require compulsory internship). For residents outside of Switzerland, you will have to find your own accommodation in order to apply for the L or B work permit.

We offer you a very exciting and dynamic work environment, the opportunity to become part of a fast-growing company and an ambitious team that is on a mission to change the industrial inspection market, a chance to leverage your experience and bring in your own ideas, a fair market salary, an attractive and fun environment in the city of Zurich.
